meaning: The ICP fit panel deliberately layers the pulsatile band at the bottom, the recording at 0.4 opacity in the middle, and the non-pulsatile mean on top, because the mean is the curve the fit was scored against. The comment also records that a rejected alternative (mean last at 0.5 with a halo) was tried.

could_move.what: Comparison figures in the CIS report show the recording partly covered by the mean curve, so overlap judged by eye may look tighter or looser than the residuals are.
Decks where the pulsatile band is a full-height block during compression hide the recording behind it.
The 'still legible' claim about the alternative ordering is an assertion I cannot verify from the code as it stands.

expectation: No effect on fitted parameters or residuals; it changes how tight the fit appears. Magnitude unknown and deck-dependent, largest where the pulsatile band is tall.

check.why: Confirms the real draw order and opacities in the panel match the comment, without re-fitting.
